items.feature: Sidebar entry that returns to Home, plus a keyboard command to go Home
items.why: The Home row in Sidebar.tsx selects Home, and PaletteHost.tsx handles nav.home (go-home) through the keybinding dispatcher.

items.feature: Sidebar top bar with a sidebar toggle button and back/forward history arrows
items.why: The Sidebar.tsx top bar has a toggle button (toggleSidebar) and back/forward arrows driven by useNavHistory (src/state/useNavHistory.ts, history.ts), disabled at the ends; nav.back/nav.forward use the same handlers. REA capture matches the reference layout.

items.feature: Computer/account switcher at the top of the sidebar (initial avatar, name, chevron)
items.why: #410 on 9930339: AccountMenu.tsx replaces the static row: an 'Account menu' button with the initial avatar, "<name>'s Mac" (or 'My Mac') from the registered local_account (macOS full name or git user.name) and a chevron, opening a 260 px menu with the git email heading and Settings, as Conductor's zna @9,957,506 does for a single personal organization. Conductor's organization list, Create organization, Upgrade to Pro and Log out need its cloud account and are left out; Conductor also hides the row with nobody signed in, while ours always shows the local user.

items.feature: Primary nav rows Home, Create and Search above the workspace list
items.why: Home, Create (opens the create dialog) and Search (opens the command palette) rows with shortcut hints above the workspace list (Sidebar.tsx); REA capture matches the reference.

items.feature: Workspaces listed under their repository, repositories as collapsible groups
items.why: Repos from conductor.db (reposFromDb in src/state/persisted.ts) render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, toggleRepo); collapsed ids persist in UI prefs.

items.feature: Workspace list grouped under a sentence-case 'my workspaces' label rather than an uppercase repositories header
items.why: Sentence-case 'My workspaces' section header with a hover menu replaces the uppercase Repositories header (Sidebar.tsx). Its collapsed state is not persisted.

items.feature: Manual, persisted ordering of repositories
items.why: Repos drag to reorder in Sidebar.tsx (draggable rows, onDrop; order logic in src/state/repoOrder.ts, tested). The store calls the registered db_reorder_repos (sidebar_repo_commands.rs, #283), which writes repos.display_order, and db_list_repos reads it back in that order.

items.feature: Hide and unhide a repository, with a toggle to show hidden ones
items.why: The repo menu has Hide repository / Unhide repository, and the list ends with a Show hidden repositories toggle (Sidebar.tsx, visibleRepos). The store calls the registered db_set_repo_hidden (sidebar_repo_commands.rs, #283), which writes repos.hidden.

items.feature: Per-repository icon (icon, emoji, favicon or uploaded image) next to the repo name
items.why: #315 (0f82f19): RepoIcon (src/components/RepoIcon.tsx, rules in src/state/repoIcon.ts) replaces the initial in the sidebar repo header and follows Conductor's U9 order: emoji, stored image or bundled icon name, a favicon found in the repo, the GitHub owner's avatar, then the initial. Change icon (RepoIconDialog.tsx, from the repo menu or right-click) has Icons (Conductor's 238 names), Emoji, Favicon and Upload tabs, search and Reset. db_set_repo_icon (registered in lib.rs) writes repos.icon through openconductor_db::repos::set_icon; repo_favicon checks Conductor's 28 favicon paths in order. Known difference: the Emoji tab is a curated subset because REA could not extract Conductor's runtime-loaded emoji dataset (REA gap recorded in #315).

items.feature: Add-repository control reachable from the sidebar
items.why: The My workspaces menu (HeaderMenu in Sidebar.tsx) runs openProject in App.tsx: folder picker, inspect_project_folder, add_repository, which now records the repo in conductor.db (on_repository_added).

items.feature: Workspace row shows the workspace name, distinguishing user-set from generated names
items.why: #370 on 66a892a: workspaceLabel (src/components/sidebarLabel.ts, tested) follows Conductor's $V (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @2,153,907): a user-set name, then any stored workspace_name (reposFromDb maps workspaceName), then the PR title, then the branch prettified with the configured branch prefix stripped (useBranchPrefix; 'sven/dark-mode' -> 'Dark mode'), unless it equals intended_target_branch ?? 'main', else the directory name. Rename sets user_set_workspace_name (#315). The PR title now refreshes for every on-screen row through the 5-minute sidebar PR poll (sidebarPrPoll.ts), not only the open workspace.

items.feature: Workspace branch visible from the sidebar row
items.why: The row label is the prettified branch (workspaceLabel, unless it equals the target branch) and the tooltip shows the raw branch; since #337 the leading icon is the row status icon, which is the branch icon (Ready) for a workspace with a remote and no PR, as in the reference rows.

items.feature: Row status icon from workspace state, then the sessions' aggregated status, then PR state, else branch/local (not the manual Backlog/In progress status, which only groups the status-grouped sidebar)
items.why: On 66a892a the row icon follows Conductor's chain: rowStatus({workspaceState: ws.state, session, pr: ws.pr}). #370 closed two gaps: the session status is now aggregated over every chat of the workspace (reasonChat chatStatuses -> workspaceSessionStatus, nTr order), and every on-screen row polls its PR every 5 minutes like Conductor's G5e (sidebarPrPoll.ts / sidebarPrPoller.ts, batched per repository), so PR states reach rows that are not open and come back after a restart once the row is on screen. Still missing: the chat queue's SessionStatus is only idle/working/cancelling/error, so needs_plan_response, needs_user_permission, needs_user_input and waiting never reach the icon.

items.feature: Line additions/deletions on each row, colored, with a setting to color unselected rows
items.why: Each row shows +/- counts from the registered sidebar_workspace_changes (merge base with the target branch, committed and uncommitted, lockfiles skipped as in Conductor's FPt; useRowDiffStat.ts, sidebarDiffStat.ts), fetched for on-screen or active rows. Unselected rows are muted unless the colored_sidebar_diffs setting is on (styles.css data-colored-sidebar-diffs, AppearancePage.tsx).

items.feature: Unread marker, mark-as-unread action and jump-to-next-unread command
items.why: #431 on 93f1846: Go to next unread (chat.nextAttention, Cmd+Alt+L; first under the palette's Navigation while something is unread) opens unread workspaces in Conductor's Qre order (updatedAt, then createdAt, then id; index-BGEQ8YjU.js @1,128,168), with Cmd+Alt+L skipping the open workspace and archived workspaces never counted (src/state/nextUnread.ts, palette/fromAppState.ts, PaletteHost.tsx). db_list_workspaces returns updated_at and chat_messages_save moves it forward on a user message through workspaces::touch, as Conductor's setSessionUpdatedAt does (index @1,066,404; migration 85 drops the trigger). Row menu toggles unread (R), unread rows render semibold and opening a row clears it, written through db_set_workspace_unread. Still partial: nothing sets unread by itself (Conductor's applyTurnCompletionTails @1,529,959 and markUnreadIfNotViewing @1,500,167), unread is per workspace rather than per chat (sessions.unread_count), there is no Next unread button over the composer (renderApp g1o, char @7,530,225), and Codex sends do not persist the updated_at bump. #443 (open) covers the composer button, Codex persistence and auto-unread on turn end and Codex approvals; per-chat unread and plan/question waits would remain.

items.feature: Pin workspaces into a pinned group at the top
items.why: Pin/unpin from the row menu or P, and a Pinned group above My workspaces (src/state/sidebarOrder.ts, SidebarSections.tsx). In the desktop app the store writes each change through the registered db_set_workspace_pinned (sidebarPersist.ts, sidebar_workspace_commands.rs), which sets workspaces.pinned_at; reposFromDb maps it back on reload.

items.feature: User navigation sections: create, rename, delete, emoji; move a workspace into or out of a section
items.why: #370 on 66a892a: the section header menu (Edit section, New section…, Delete section) and the sidebar's 'New section…' open SectionDialog (name + emoji); the row menu's Move to section ▸ lists every section, 'New section…' (creates one holding the workspace) and 'Remove from section'. The edits are pure functions after Conductor's index-chunk _Y/SY/wY/yY/kY/V2 (src/state/navigationSections.ts, tested), the projection follows renderApp usa (first section wins, archived and hidden-repo workspaces left out, newest first), and the whole layout is read and written through db_read_navigation_sections / db_write_navigation_sections (sidebar_section_commands.rs, registered in lib.rs) into conductor.db's navigation_sections tables with Conductor's tve updatedAt stamp. Not wired: reorderSection (bY) has no UI yet; that belongs with sidebar.drag-to-section.

items.feature: Drag a workspace row onto a section
items.why: #412 on 93e4881: useSidebarDrag.tsx (wired in Sidebar.tsx) is a pointer drag after Conductor's controller `esa` (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, elementFromPoint hit test at byte 10,091,139, re-checked in the decoded bundle): a press becomes a drag after 5 px; a workspace row drops onto a section, onto Pinned or onto My workspaces, and a drop that leaves it where it is is no target; a section header drags to reorder sections (reorderSection, Conductor's bY); Escape, blur and pointercancel abort, the click ending a drag is swallowed, and the list edge-scrolls 4-16 px a frame. Pinning unassigns the workspace from its section as Conductor's pin mutation does. Drops go through the store's section actions, which #370 persists to conductor.db's navigation_sections tables. Rows inside a section stay newest first, as in Conductor (usa), so there is no row order to drag. Pure drop rules tested in navigationSectionsDrag.test.ts; not exercised end to end in the desktop app by the verifier.

items.feature: Workspace numbers shown optionally, with Cmd+1..9 switching
items.why: workspace.switchTo1..9 switch rows over sidebarOrder, and holding the switch modifier for 500 ms shows 1..9 in place of the first nine rows' icons (src/state/shortcutHint.ts, SidebarWorkspaceRow.tsx). The workspaces.number column is not shown and there is no setting to show numbers.

items.feature: Next/previous workspace commands
items.why: workspace.next / workspace.previous handled in PaletteHost.tsx through stepWorkspace (wraps, sidebar order).

items.feature: Search/filter workspaces
items.why: The sidebar Search row opens the command palette (onSearch -> setPaletteOpen in App.tsx), which searches workspaces by name, branch and repo (src/palette/search/model.ts).

items.feature: Rename a workspace (local only), optionally also renaming the branch
items.why: #315 (0f82f19): row menu Rename opens RenameWorkspaceDialog (Sidebar.tsx). It calls db_rename_workspace (sidebar_rename_commands.rs, registered in lib.rs), which follows Conductor's renameWorkspace (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @1,050,054): refuses an initializing workspace, a directory name another workspace of the repo uses and an invalid name; for a ready worktree it leaves the worktree in place, adds a sibling symlink recorded as secondary_directory_name and queues the old link in symlinks_pending_deletion; otherwise it rewrites directory_name and workspace_path. workspace_name and user_set_workspace_name = 1 are saved (workspace_rename.rs). The remembered Also rename branch checkbox renames the branch through rename_workspace_branch and sets user_set_branch_name (db_mark_user_set_branch_name). Not built: the CLI 'workspace rename' (no CLI in the rebuild).

items.feature: Archive with confirmation, refusing while a git operation is in progress, recording an archive commit
items.why: #391 (274ac80) replaces the row-only db_archive_workspace with archive_workspace (src-tauri/src/workspace_archive/, flow.rs), which the row menu, WorkspaceView, the palette and archive on merge all reach through startArchive (store.ts). It follows Conductor's dYe/mYe (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @ ~966,478 / ~969,254): checkpoint conductor-archive-<id>, refuse in safe mode while a merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert is in progress with the sticky warning and Archive retry (discardGitOperationState), archive commit = HEAD kept under refs/conductor-archive-heads/<id>, row state/branch/archive_commit, archive script, .context move, worktree removal and delete_branch_on_archive. #397 (aa32456) closes the last gap: the running-agents check folds every chat of the workspace (workspaceAgentStatus; working, cancelling or waiting block, as dYe), and every archive calls stopWorkspaceAgents, which stops each working or cancelling chat of the workspace (stopChat), as Conductor's Z$ (@974,859) calls cancelSession for every session of a local workspace. Conductor's cancel also settles a 'waiting' session (@3,013,752); no OpenConductor chat reports 'waiting', so there is nothing to settle. Read on f6c05d7 with the bundle (sha256 prefix b5b01f33); not run in the desktop app.

items.feature: Browse archived workspaces and unarchive one
items.why: #437 on 1944b98 builds the UI over #391's unarchive_workspace backend. Palette: 'View archived workspaces' (fromAppState.ts VIEW_ARCHIVED_ACTION) switches to the Workspaces tab with archived shown and the query cleared; the Workspaces tab's 'Archived workspaces' filter has Conductor's three options 'Hiding archived' / 'Showing all' / 'Only archived' (archivedList.ts); archived rows come from conductor.db through listArchivedWorkspaces / archivedFromRows (PaletteHost.tsx) and each has an 'Unarchive workspace' button. Opening one shows it read-only (store archivedOpen, ArchivedWorkspaceView.tsx) with the 'This workspace is archived.' banner and Unarchive in the header. Unarchive follows Conductor's CWt: branchDeleted/branchTaken/branchDiverged open 'Restore to new branch?' (RestoreWorkspaceDialog.tsx), which restores onto a unique -vN branch; gitignored include files are copied back; a folder in the way gives the 'Clear & unarchive' toast; a failed archive offers 'Delete permanently' through delete_workspace. All 16 user-facing strings were found as plain text in Conductor's renderApp/index bundles. Not run in the desktop app by the verifier; the new e2e (tests/e2e/sidebar-archived-view.e2e.mjs) passed in #437's CI. Home's All workspaces archive filter is a separate gap, recorded under home.status-overview.

items.feature: Resizable sidebar and show/hide toggles for left and right sidebars
items.why: The rail (useSidebarWidth, panelPrefs.tsx) has resized the left sidebar since #332, clamped to 192–480 and saved as left_panel_width; #423 (99edc40) brings it to Conductor's Nta (@ 9,970,616): primary-button drag previews without saving, release saves, a cancelled pointer reverts, double-click resets to 256 and saves, and the aside is capped at 40% of the window. Left toggles: top-bar button, ⌘B (view.toggleLeftSidebar) and the native View > Toggle Left Sidebar item; right: ⌥⌘B (view.toggleRightSidebar, right_panel_visible) and View > Toggle Right Sidebar (menu.rs emits toggle_left_sidebar / toggle_right_sidebar, App.tsx listens, as Conductor's lva/ova @ 10,931,680). REA gap: which submenu Conductor appends the two items to was not decompiled; they go in View here. Not run in the desktop app.

items.feature: Optional CPU/memory usage readout in the sidebar footer
items.why: #410 on 9930339: Settings › Experimental 'Show sidebar resource usage' (sidebar_resource_usage in conductor.db settings, default off, AppPrefRows.tsx) shows ResourceUsagePill in the sidebar's top bar beside back/forward, where Conductor mounts it (renderApp Isa/bna @9,942,220), despite the setting text saying footer. The pill hides under 200 px of sidebar and goes icon-only under 260 px, polls the registered get_resource_usage every 2 s, and opens the Resources popover (qta @9,933,654): include terminals, group by workspace, tree/flat, copy, CPU/Memory totals, sortable Name/CPU/Mem table, Show all past 7 rows. Inferred, not decompiled: which processes Conductor samples, its label rules and redaction (evidence/sidebar-resource-usage/NOTES.md).

items.feature: Sidebar footer with help and settings icon buttons
items.why: Footer HelpMenu (src/components/HelpMenu.tsx, helpMenuItems.ts) and a Settings icon button that opens settings; REA capture matches the reference footer.

items.feature: Sidebar transparency (vibrancy) setting
items.why: No vibrancy or transparency setting or window effect; the sidebar is a CSS color-mix fill (styles.css).

items.feature: Sidebar background, border and width match the reference screens in light and dark
items.why: Measured on REA captures at 1440x900 on 0e2531b: sidebar edge at x=255 in both, sidebar fill #1c1817 dark / #fcfcfb light and main #141110 / #ffffff identical to the reference. REA compare-web-screenshots (t=24): 0.6-0.9% of sidebar pixels differ (was 3.1-5.4%), from text and data only.

items.feature: Workspace actions menu on a row (copy info, rename, archive, pin, section)
items.why: #400 merged as be4f789 (squash of 6e038d3): the row menu reads Mark as unread/read (R), Pin/Unpin (P), Set status ▸, Move to section ▸ (#370), Rename (#315), Copy link (⌘⇧C) and Archive (WorkspaceActionsMenu.tsx). Copy link puts openconductor://workspace?id=<id> on the clipboard with the 'Copied link' / 'Failed to copy link' toasts (src/workspace/link.ts, Conductor's XV and $$); workspace.copyLink is bound to Cmd+Shift+C in keybindings/registry.ts. Out of this item: the copied link opens nothing until app.deep-link (unowned) handles openconductor:// URLs.

items.feature: Empty state when there are no repositories or workspaces
items.why: With no repos, Sidebar.tsx shows a muted one-line empty state under My workspaces (matches the REA empty-Home capture).

items.feature: Sidebar add menu offering the three Home actions plus recent local repositories not yet added (spinner while loading)
items.why: #423 (99edc40): the My workspaces header menu's 'Add project…' opens the add-repository popover on the next frame, and ⌥⌘A (nav.addRepository) opens it too, as Conductor's wra/yra do (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @ 10,069,794). SidebarAddRepositoryMenu (AddRepositoryMenu.tsx) shows Conductor's shared body Gji (@ 9,785,064): Open project, Open GitHub project, Quick start, then 'Recents' with a braille spinner row while loading. Recents come from recent_local_repos.rs, a Rust port of Conductor's MQo script (last 2,000 zsh history cd targets plus .git dirs up to 3 levels under the fixed roots, newest first, at most 8), leaving out folders already added (qQo); a Recents row adds that folder through the same checks as Open project. Pure parts are unit-tested (addRepositoryMenuModel.test.ts). Not run in the desktop app.

items.feature: Left sidebar visibility and width persisted as settings (default visible, width 256)
items.why: Re-read on 99edc40 (stale since #332, 7d2d4a2): left_panel_visible (default true), left_panel_width (default 256, clamped 192–480) and right_panel_visible are rows in conductor.db's settings table (src-tauri/src/app_prefs/), loaded and written by useSidebarVisiblePref / useSidebarWidth (panelPrefs.tsx), as Conductor does. The browser build, which has no database, falls back to defaults.

items.feature: Home is the root route and the default screen
items.why: Since #322 the selection has a {kind: 'root'} entry for '/': the store starts there (startSelection, src/state/selectors.ts) unless a workspace was open, and removing or archiving the open workspace or its repository falls back to it, as Conductor's '/' (Wls) does. A start path of /all-workspaces opens the Home list, and #381 adds /first-run-onboarding before it (main.tsx FirstRunGate). There is no URL router: routes are selection kinds, which a window with no address bar does not expose.

items.feature: Home renders nothing while the organization loads and redirects a cloud organization to all-workspaces
items.why: Not applicable locally. REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest; evidence/screens/first-run-onboarding.md, #381): Wls (@2,118,579) returns null while so()/rl loads the signed-in user's organizations from Conductor's cloud API and redirects to /all-workspaces when fc(org) is 'cloud'. OpenConductor has no account and no organizations, so there is no organization load and no cloud organization; the local startup wait shows FirstRunGate's loader before Home, as Bxa does.

items.feature: Centered wordmark (light/dark variants) above three label-only entry cards in a 1-to-3 column grid, whole area a window drag region
items.why: HomeScreen.tsx: centred wordmark above three label-only cards in a 1-to-3 grid, drag region, fade-in; REA capture puts wordmark and cards at the reference positions (cards y 368-495). Differences: GitHub card cloud vs globe icon, Quick start sparkle vs folder-plus; the wordmark is our own brand by design.

items.feature: Home background and entry-card fill match the reference screens in light and dark
items.why: Measured on REA captures on 0e2531b after #269: main background (#141110 dark, #ffffff light), entry-card fill (#211e1c / #fafaf9) and card border (#373433 / #eae8e6) are pixel-identical to the reference at the sampled points.

items.feature: When the left sidebar is hidden, Home shows a toggle button with its shortcut, offset past the traffic lights
items.why: HomeScreen.tsx shows the toggle only while the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint, offset past the traffic lights.

items.feature: Add an existing local repository via a folder picker, with default-branch detection
items.why: Open project card: native pickFolder, inspect_project_folder, add_repository (registered); default branch from the backend.

items.feature: Open project: folder picker; no .git leads to an add dialog that offers git init; a missing origin (non-GitHub setting off) leads to the same dialog; otherwise add with a file:// remote; errors in a toast
items.why: decideOpenProject (src/state/openProject.ts) sends a folder with no .git or no origin to GitHubRepoDialog, whose registered github_repo_create (github_repo.rs) runs git init when needed and publishes; otherwise it adds with a file:// remote; errors in a toast. There is no non-GitHub setting (always behaves as off).

items.feature: Clone a GitHub repository by URL into a chosen folder, with progress
items.why: CloneGitHubRepoDialog.tsx takes a URL and a location with a Browse picker and calls the registered clone_repository; progress streams over a Channel into a log and errors map through cloneErrorMessage (src/state/cloneDialog.ts); the clone is recorded in conductor.db.

items.feature: Create a new project: local folder, git init, private GitHub repo (required, as in Conductor's Quick start), then a first workspace
items.why: Quick start (CreateProjectDialog.tsx -> create_new_project) runs git init with a first commit or create-next-app, creates the private GitHub repo, registers the project with add_repository, then since #350 creates the real first workspace through create_workspace and starts the repository's setup script (src/home/createFirstWorkspace.ts, tested in firstWorkspace.test.ts) and opens it under the backend repo id. As in Conductor's gbi (@2,103,713, evidence/screens/create-project.md) the GitHub step cannot be skipped. Not run end to end in the packaged app.

items.feature: Adding an already-added repository again (Clone or Open project) makes a new project: no duplicate check, a new repos row, and Clone picks a unique folder (name-v1, name-v2)
items.why: Clone now matches (#343): the Clone dialog result is added under its backend id and a second clone of an added remote becomes its own project in a <name>-v1 folder (sameRepoRecord, src/state/addRepo.ts, tested; naming::bump since #379), as Conductor's g2t/C2t do. Open project still differs: App.tsx openProject refuses an already-added folder with REPO_EXISTS (findExistingRepo), and add_repository returns the existing id for a known path, while Conductor inserts a second repos row for the same folder named <name>-v1 (evidence/screens/duplicate-repo.md).

items.feature: Home explains that a repository must be added before creating a workspace
items.why: With no repositories, CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx explains a repository is needed and offers an Add repository menu (Open project or Clone repo).

items.feature: Home list shows each workspace's active session status or its last-activity time (Conductor: needs plan response, needs permission, needs input, working, cancelling, waiting); status-matrix option and mine-vs-all
items.why: #322 adds the Home list (AllWorkspaces.tsx, src/home/allWorkspaces.ts): grouped by last activity with counts, unread rows semibold, diff stat and a short relative time. The status column shows only 'working' (a spinner): our session status has only working/idle, so Conductor's other active statuses (needs plan response, needs permission, needs input, cancelling, waiting) never show, the same gap as sidebar.ws-status. The status-matrix toggle (internal_workspace_status_matrix, Settings > Experimental @10,701,242) and mine-vs-all (team organization sidebar, 'My workspaces' @10,055,740) are not built; #322 records them as cloud-only. Home's 'Archived workspaces' filter (Hiding archived / Showing all / Only archived, allWorkspaces.ts) never sees an archived workspace on 1944b98: homeRows (AllWorkspaces.tsx) takes only state.repos, and reposFromDb drops archived rows (persisted.ts HIDDEN_STATES), so 'Only archived' is always empty and 'Showing all' shows no archived row, unlike Conductor's Home list; adf1f469 owns the follow-up that feeds listArchivedWorkspaces into homeRows.

items.feature: Dashboard and all-workspaces routes
items.why: /all-workspaces is implemented by #322: the sidebar Home row, nav.home and the palette open AllWorkspaces, and a start path of /all-workspaces opens it. /dashboard is missing: REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest) shows route lta (@11,520,499) and a sidebar 'Dashboard' row (@10,029,038) shown when the dashboard_enabled setting is on (default 'false' in the index chunk's settings defaults); the rebuild has neither the route nor the setting.

items.feature: Recent workspaces list
items.why: Re-read with REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest): 'Recent workspaces' is the command palette's All-tab heading with an empty query (m_a @10,909,908), not a Home list. Conductor keeps recentWorkspaceIds (most recent first, cap XOt = 5, recordViewedWorkspace) in its persisted UI store (partialize includes recentWorkspaceIds, index chunk @3,121,897), so the list survives a restart. Ours (src/palette/PaletteHost.tsx) shows the same heading and order but keeps up to 8 ids in React state only, so it is empty after a restart and holds 3 more than Conductor.

items.feature: Narrow the repository list by project: the sidebar section header's Filter by project submenu (All projects, then each repository; shown with more than one repository; stored in sidebar_repo_filter) and the palette Projects tab (Search projects...). Home and the Add-repository menu have no repo search
items.why: #315 (0f82f19) mounts #354's Filter by project submenu (ProjectFilterSubmenu) in the My workspaces section header menu (Sidebar.tsx), and filterRepoGroups narrows the repo groups while Pinned keeps every repo's rows, as Conductor's pra/hBi do (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @10,019,058). The submenu renders nothing with one repository or none, offers All projects then each repository, and a stale filter is cleared once repos load. In the desktop app the choice is saved as conductor.db settings key sidebar_repo_filter (raw repository id; All projects deletes the row) through useAppPrefs/set_app_pref (src-tauri/src/app_prefs, openconductor_db::app_settings::keys::SIDEBAR_REPO_FILTER), matching Conductor's z6t updateSetting/deleteSetting (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @420,066, REA by sidebar builder 0c122c06). Only the browser build, which has no database, falls back to localStorage. The palette Projects tab (projectResults, Search projects...) was already built. Home and the Add-repository menu have no repo search, as in Conductor.

items.feature: Clone dialog shows recent repositories with loading placeholders and a screen-reader status
items.why: CloneGitHubRepoDialog.tsx loads recent repos through the registered github_recent_repos (cached 2 min), shows three skeleton rows in a role=status region with a screen-reader label while loading, renders nothing when empty, and fills the URL on click.

items.feature: First-run onboarding route before Home
items.why: #381: FirstRunGate (src/onboarding/FirstRunGate.tsx, mounted around App in main.tsx) reads first_time_onboarding_step from the settings table (onboarding_commands.rs, crates/openconductor-db onboarding.rs) and shows /first-run-onboarding on a fresh install with no repositories, as Conductor's Pya/Bxa do (evidence/screens/first-run-onboarding.md); Continue writes 999 and DONE and goes to '/'. Three slides with titles and descriptions, ArrowDown and Enter. By design: no Conductor account (always 'Continue'), placeholder media instead of Conductor's videos, no analytics. Covered by tests/e2e/first-run.e2e.mjs and firstRun.test.ts.

items.feature: Repositories and workspaces persist in SQLite (conductor.db shape), surviving restart
items.why: In the desktop app the sidebar and Home load repos and workspaces from conductor.db through db_list_repos / db_list_workspaces (persistence_commands.rs); localStorage keeps only UI prefs; add, clone, create, rename and archive write rows. Gaps: remote_url is never written, and Quick start / palette placeholder workspaces are not saved.

items.feature: Create-workspace action per repository (sidebar and Home)
items.why: Cmd+N, the sidebar Create row, each repo's + and New workspace menu item (Sidebar.tsx), and the palette action all open CreateWorkspaceDialog.

items.feature: Full-screen create-workspace page with its own composer and tab navigation
items.why: Create is still a modal (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx) with a prompt box, create-from picker, repo and base-branch selects and a name field, not the reference's full-screen composer with tabs; agent, model and effort come from Settings › Default models with no picker in the composer. Re-read on 0f82f19: unchanged. PR #388 (Conductor's composer and the full-screen /create page behind Settings > Experimental > New workspace page) is open, not merged, so it is not scored.

items.feature: Create a workspace from a PR, branch or issue
items.why: CreateFromPicker.tsx PR, branch and issue tabs; PRs and GitHub issues come from the registered pr_list_open and gh_issue_list_open (#203), a PR passes prNumber so fork heads are fetched (#197), an issue seeds the first message. Not covered: Linear issues, lookup beyond the 100 loaded items.

items.feature: Choose the base branch new workspaces branch from; remember the intended target branch
items.why: Base-branch select fed by list_branches, defaulting to the repo default branch, passed to create_workspace and written to conductor.db as initialization_parent_branch / intended_target_branch (#224).

items.feature: Branch picker with search, loading, empty and error states
items.why: Branch tab of CreateFromPicker.tsx with search, loading, empty and error states over list_branches (createFrom.ts statusLine, dedupeBranches).

items.feature: Each workspace is a git worktree on its own branch in a configurable workspaces directory
items.why: #375 adds the conductor_root_path setting: WorkspaceManager::with_root and workspaces_dir put workspaces under <root>/workspaces/<repo slug> (archive records and default clones under the same root). Settings > Advanced RootPathRow (Browse, 'Change root path?', change_conductor_root, which forgets repos, saves and restarts) and Repo settings > Misc 'Workspaces path' (repo_workspaces_path) make it reachable. #379 brings the -v1/-v2 name bump (naming::bump). Deliberate difference: with no setting the root is the app data directory, not Conductor's ~/conductor.

items.feature: Branch name prefix setting (none, user-based or custom)
items.why: Settings › Git (GitPage.tsx) edits branch_prefix_type / branch_prefix_custom; App.tsx reads the registered branch_prefix_settings (with the gh username) each time the dialog opens and the dialog applies resolveBranchPrefix.

items.feature: Generated placeholder name/branch, replaced when the agent names the branch (rename-on-branch setting)
items.why: City placeholder with rarity badge (naming.ts); after the first message renameAfterFirstMessage renames workspace and branch via rename_workspace_branch. No rename-on-branch toggle (always on), and placeholder_branch_name is not stored.

items.feature: Validate workspace names and branch names before creating
items.why: buildCreateRequest (createFlow.ts) validates name, repo, base branch and source with per-field errors; create_workspace rejects invalid branch names (git.rs).

items.feature: Copy ignored files (worktreeinclude / include globs / .env*) into each new workspace
items.why: The create path resolves .worktreeinclude / include globs / .env* through files_to_copy.rs and copies them into each new worktree; initialization_files_copied is not written to conductor.db.

items.feature: Run the repository setup script on creation and keep its log
items.why: After create_workspace, CreateWorkspaceDialog's startSetupScript calls scripts_config then setup_script_start, registered in lib.rs over the now-linked oc-scripts ScriptService; the workspace shows running-setup and the Setup tab (ScriptsPanel.tsx) shows output and the log path.

items.feature: Initializing state with progress while the workspace is created
items.why: #327 adds a pendingLaunches store (src/workspace/pendingLaunches.ts, a port of Conductor's Y5e with the 120 s expiry): CreateWorkspaceDialog adds a launch on submit and removes it when the create finishes or fails, and RepoWorkspaceList/PendingWorkspaceRow (Sidebar.tsx) show an inert 'Untitled' row with a spinner ('Creating workspace...'), also in a collapsed group. Still no initializing workspace view and no initialization log, and the loader is a CSS spinner rather than Conductor's sprite.

items.feature: Creation failure surfaced with logs; incomplete workspaces cleaned up on start
items.why: A failed create shows the backend error in the dialog and on_create_failed drops the pending row; a failed setup raises a toast pointing to the Setup log (setupWatch.ts); startup runs delete_incomplete -> delete_if_initializing (#224). No initialization_log_path for worktree failures.

items.feature: Create a workspace directly inside a sidebar section
items.why: #419 on d353535: a section's header menu starts with 'Create workspace' (Conductor's oBi @10,005,110), which opens the create dialog with that section; its Create button reads 'Create in <name>'. Opened without a section while sections exist, Create splits with a 'Create in section' menu listing every section (iQo @9,711,015). After the create the workspace is assigned to the section and unpinned (assignSection, persisted with the sections layout); a section deleted meanwhile keeps the workspace and warns with Conductor's SECTION_ASSIGN_FAILED text (src/workspace/createInSection.ts, tested).

items.feature: Draft the first agent message, then create the workspace and send it
items.why: seedTranscript queues the first message and ChatPanel sends it with sendReason over the registered reason_open_chat / reason_prompt (#194), starting the workspace's first agent session; it also drives the rename. The draft's model and effort are not passed to the chat.

items.feature: Assign a per-workspace number on creation
items.why: #305 (9883bb3; its squash title says evidence, but it carries the code; the earlier 'evidence only' reading was wrong): begin_workspace numbers the initializing row with workspaces::next_number (MAX(number)+1 across repositories, crates/openconductor-db/src/workspaces.rs) and finish_workspace keeps it, or assigns one if the row was a leftover; create_workspace returns it (CreatedWorkspaceDto.number), and db_list_workspaces/reposFromDb carry Workspace.number, which the Home list matches as W-<n>. Archived rows keep their number, so none is reused. Conductor's server assigns the number instead (evidence/create-workspace/README.md); a local rule is the only option without it. Covered by persistence test each_new_workspace_gets_the_next_number_across_repositories. Showing W-<n> on rows is sidebar.ws-numbers, scored there.

items.feature: Optionally start the run script automatically after setup
items.why: Settings > Experimental 'Auto-run after setup' (ExperimentalPage.tsx) calls auto_run_after_setup_get/_set (registered in lib.rs), which write [scripts] auto_run_after_setup to the user settings.toml the oc-scripts loader reads (config/user.rs, #324); after a completed setup ScriptService::after_setup -> should_auto_run starts the default run script, a failed setup never auto-runs, and a repo layer still overrides (crates/scripts service tests). User scope, default off, as in Conductor 0.87.6 (REA IRt/fQe, evidence/run-scripts/NOTES.md). Not run end to end in the packaged app.
